entries.zh-Hans: 离线进度未能保存，本次读档未生效。请重试，原存档仍可读取。
entries.en: Offline progress could not be saved, so the load was not applied. Please retry; the original save remains available.

entries.zh-Hans: 收益未能保存，待领奖励已保留，请重试。
entries.en: Rewards could not be saved. Your unclaimed rewards are kept; please retry.

entries.zh-Hans: 开箱结果未能保存，宝箱和原奖励种子已保留，请重试。
entries.en: Chest rewards could not be saved. The chest and its original reward seed are kept; please retry.

entries.zh-Hans: 保存失败，请检查存储空间或写入权限后重试。
entries.en: Save failed. Check storage space or write permissions, then retry.

entries.zh-Hans: 最新进度未能保存，暂未退出。请重试保存。
entries.en: Your latest progress could not be saved. The game is still open; please retry saving.

entries.zh-Hans: 该存档来自较新版本，请更新游戏后读取。
entries.en: This save is from a newer version. Update the game before loading it.

entries.zh-Hans: 未找到有效存档或备份，原文件已保留。
entries.en: No valid save or backup was found. The original files have been kept.

entries.zh-Hans: 已从最近的有效备份恢复进度。
entries.en: Progress restored from the latest valid backup.
